resources.string: Automates liking nearby people in SayHi. Only runs when you press Start.

Two separate steps:

A) INSTALL (Play Protect)
Turn off Play Protect scanning briefly to install the APK, or use ADB on a PC. That only affects installation.

B) ACCESSIBILITY (Android restriction)
Sideloaded apps need an extra allow:
1) App Settings → menu (⋮) → Allow restricted settings
2) Then Settings → Accessibility → turn ON SayHi Likes

Play Protect off does NOT replace step B — you still need Allow restricted settings.
Ready — press Start when SayHi is open
Turn on Accessibility for SayHi Likes first
No likes yet — names appear here after a run.
